==== Lemmings_Psygnosis_HFE.hfe
HFE v3, 84 tracks, 2 sides, 250 kbps, encoding 1, interface 4
Sides listed only when unusual (-v lists all). Sector flags: /size, @T.S ID differs from
the physical track, !id ID CRC bad, !dat data CRC bad, - no data field, del deleted mark,
W weak (reads differently each pass), ~pct data rate vs 250kbps, ^ ID inside another
sector's data, * duplicate number.
